title: Exhaustion of an open U ⊆ ℝ^N by countably many open sets of finite μ-measure (μ finite on compact subsets of U)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^N be open, and let μ be a (Borel) measure on ℝ^N with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U. Then there are open sets W_0, W_1, W_2, … ⊆ ℝ^N such that μ(W_i) < ∞ for every i ∈ ℕ and ⋃_{i ∈ ℕ} W_i = U.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → ∃ W : ℕ → Set (Rn N), (∀ i, IsOpen (W i)) ∧ (∀ i, μ (W i) < ∞) ∧ ⋃ i, W i = U
